facts.business: The Ravalgaon Sugar Farm Limited previously operated in sugar and confectionery segments but has been inactive since the sale of its sugar business in 2018 and divestment of confectionery trademarks in 2023-24, with no operating segments as of March 31, 2026.

auditor.name: Not specified in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (i) Segment Reporting - Company inactive with no operating segments; (ii) Going Concern Assessment - Net loss of Rs.491.22 Lakhs but net worth of Rs.1,017.87 Lakhs; (iii) Legal claim for gratuity payments of Rs.62.10 lakhs to 21 former seasonal workers; (iv) Water usage charges dispute of Rs.15.80 lakhs with Water Resources Department; (v) Electricity duty exemption withdrawal matter with Supreme Court order dated March 25, 2026.

key_risks: Company has been inactive with no operating segments since divestment of confectionery business in 2023-24
Reported net loss of Rs.491.22 Lakhs for FY 2025-26
Contingent liabilities of Rs.546.66 Lakhs including electricity duty, provident fund, gram panchayat cess, water charges, and gratuity claims
Ongoing legal disputes including Supreme Court review petition on electricity duty exemptions
Gratuity claim of Rs.62.10 lakhs for 21 former seasonal workers contested in Industrial Court
Water usage charges dispute of Rs.15.80 lakhs with Government of Maharashtra
